name: DEXUN AdWhiz API
description: Public REST API for DEXUN AdWhiz. Bearer-authenticated with `dxk_live_*` / `dxk_test_*` keys generated in /settings/api-keys. Per-key rate-limited by subscription tier (60 / 120 / 600 / 3000 RPM). Every authed response carries `X-RateLimit-*` headers — same data also available via `/usage`.
